set.body: Outcome: after direct locus4s adoption and checked image4s volume identity, expose a rich atlas-specific domain adapter for publication. Pair authoritative PartialSurjection support assignments with the exact parcel FiniteDomain, ordered RegionId field, metadata, display order, network hierarchy, AtlasProvenance, and exact volume or surface support identity. Project this value into the language-neutral Neuropublish domain and mapping records without Scala-derived wire encoding. Acceptance: no persistent identity uses runtime hashCode; same-sized foreign or reordered parcel domains fail; volume and surface realizations share a parcel domain only by exact ordered identity or explicit bijection; Schaefer variant fixtures, JVM and Scala.js tests, and a foreign-producer protocol fixture pass. Non-goal: no second generic Domain, Field, Region, Parcellation, or registry algebra in scalafim-atlas.
set.title: Expose exact atlas parcel domains and publication realizations
